_comment: STM pipeline configuration for Polish module. Defaults: hedge_reducer + direct_mode active. Receipt mode and casual mode disabled. Source: G0DM0D3 PAPER §3.5, WabbleSpec-adapted.

hedge_reducer.purpose: Remove hedging phrases that undermine authority of prose artifacts

direct_mode.purpose: Remove sycophantic and filler preambles from generated prose

spec_mode.purpose: Normalize modal verbs to EARS syntax: might->SHOULD, will->SHALL
spec_mode.note: Enable for spec artifact polish passes only

receipt_mode.purpose: Strip first-person from receipts, capitalize PASS/FAIL/WARN
receipt_mode.note: Managed by Clean module for receipt artifacts, not Polish

casual_mode.purpose: Replace formal connectors with plain alternatives
casual_mode.note: Off by default — opt-in only via --casual flag
